versos.grego: Ἀδελφοί, ἐὰν καὶ προλημφθῇ ἄνθρωπος ἔν τινι παραπτώματι, ὑμεῖς οἱ πνευματικοὶ καταρτίζετε τὸν τοιοῦτον ἐν πνεύματι πραΰτητος, σκοπῶν σεαυτόν, μὴ καὶ σὺ πειρασθῇς.

controles.web: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness; looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.
controles.kjv: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.
controles.livre: Irmãos, se alguém for surpreendido em algum pecado, vós que sois espirituais, restaurai o tal com espírito de mansidão, prestando atenção a ti mesmo, para que também não sejas tentado.

versos.grego: Ἀλλήλων τὰ βάρη βαστάζετε, καὶ οὕτως ἀναπληρώσετε τὸν νόμον τοῦ Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
controles.kjv: Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
controles.livre: Levai as cargas uns dos outros, e assim cumprireis a lei de Cristo.

versos.grego: εἰ γὰρ δοκεῖ τις εἶναί τι μηδὲν ὤν, φρεναπατᾷ ἑαυτόν.

controles.web: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
controles.kjv: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.
controles.livre: Pois, se alguém pensa ser alguma coisa, sendo nada, engana a si mesmo.

versos.grego: τὸ δὲ ἔργον ἑαυτοῦ δοκιμαζέτω ἕκαστος, καὶ τότε εἰς ἑαυτὸν μόνον τὸ καύχημα ἕξει καὶ οὐκ εἰς τὸν ἕτερον·

controles.web: But let each man test his own work, and then he will take pride in himself and not in his neighbor.
controles.kjv: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.
controles.livre: Cada um, porém, examine a sua própria obra, e então terá orgulho em si mesmo sozinho, e não em outro;

versos.grego: ἕκαστος γὰρ τὸ ἴδιον φορτίον βαστάσει.

controles.web: For each man will bear his own burden.
controles.kjv: For every man shall bear his own burden.
controles.livre: pois cada um levará a sua própria carga.

versos.grego: Κοινωνείτω δὲ ὁ κατηχούμενος τὸν λόγον τῷ κατηχοῦντι ἐν πᾶσιν ἀγαθοῖς.

controles.web: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.
controles.kjv: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.
controles.livre: Mas aquele que é instruído na palavra compartilhe todas as boas coisas com aquele que o instrui.

versos.grego: Μὴ πλανᾶσθε, Θεὸς οὐ μυκτηρίζεται. ὃ γὰρ ἐὰν σπείρῃ ἄνθρωπος, τοῦτο καὶ θερίσει·

controles.web: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.
controles.kjv: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
controles.livre: Não vos enganeis: Deus não se deixa escarnecer; pois, o que o ser humano semear, isso também colherá.

versos.grego: ὅτι ὁ σπείρων εἰς τὴν σάρκα ἑαυτοῦ ἐκ τῆς σαρκὸς θερίσει φθοράν, ὁ δὲ σπείρων εἰς τὸ Πνεῦμα ἐκ τοῦ Πνεύματος θερίσει ζωὴν αἰώνιον.

controles.web: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.
controles.kjv: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.
controles.livre: Pois quem semear para a sua carne, da carne colherá degradação; mas quem semear para o Espírito, do Espírito colherá a vida eterna.

versos.grego: τὸ δὲ καλὸν ποιοῦντες μὴ ἐνκακῶμεν· καιρῷ γὰρ ἰδίῳ θερίσομεν μὴ ἐκλυόμενοι.

controles.web: Let us not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season, if we don’t give up.
controles.kjv: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
controles.livre: Porém não cansemos de fazer o bem, pois no tempo devido colheremos, se não desistirmos.

versos.grego: Ἄρα οὖν ὡς καιρὸν ἔχωμεν, ἐργαζώμεθα τὸ ἀγαθὸν πρὸς πάντας, μάλιστα δὲ πρὸς τοὺς οἰκείους τῆς πίστεως.

controles.web: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.
controles.kjv: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.
controles.livre: Portanto, enquanto tivermos oportunidade, façamos o bem a todos; mas principalmente aos familiares  da fé.

versos.grego: Ἴδετε πηλίκοις ὑμῖν γράμμασιν ἔγραψα τῇ ἐμῇ χειρί.

controles.web: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.
controles.kjv: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.
controles.livre: Olhai como são grandes as letras que vos escrevi da minha mão.

versos.grego: Ὅσοι θέλουσιν εὐπροσωπῆσαι ἐν σαρκί, οὗτοι ἀναγκάζουσιν ὑμᾶς περιτέμνεσθαι, μόνον ἵνα τῷ σταυρῷ τοῦ Χριστοῦ μὴ διώκωνται.

controles.web: As many as desire to look good in the flesh, they compel you to be circumcised; only that they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.
controles.kjv: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.
controles.livre: Todos os que querem mostrar boa aparência na carne, estes vos obrigam a vos circuncidarem, somente para não serem perseguidos por causa da cruz de Cristo.

versos.grego: οὐδὲ γὰρ οἱ περιτεμνόμενοι αὐτοὶ νόμον φυλάσσουσιν, ἀλλὰ θέλουσιν ὑμᾶς περιτέμνεσθαι ἵνα ἐν τῇ ὑμετέρᾳ σαρκὶ καυχήσωνται.

controles.web: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, that they may boast in your flesh.
controles.kjv: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.
controles.livre: Pois nem mesmo os que se circuncidam guardam a Lei; mas querem que vos circuncideis, para se orgulharem de vossa carne.

versos.grego: ἐμοὶ δὲ μὴ γένοιτο καυχᾶσθαι εἰ μὴ ἐν τῷ σταυρῷ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, δι’ οὗ ἐμοὶ κόσμος ἐσταύρωται κἀγὼ κόσμῳ.

controles.web: But far be it from me to boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
controles.kjv: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.
controles.livre: Mas longe de mim esteja me orgulhar, a não ser na cruz do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo; por meio dela, o mundo está crucificado para mim, e eu para o mundo.

versos.grego: οὔτε γὰρ περιτομή τί ἐστιν οὔτε ἀκροβυστία, ἀλλὰ καινὴ κτίσις.

controles.web: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.
controles.kjv: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.
controles.livre: Pois  nem a circuncisão é coisa alguma, nem a incircuncisão; mas sim a nova criatura.

versos.grego: καὶ ὅσοι τῷ κανόνι τούτῳ στοιχήσουσιν, εἰρήνη ἐπ’ αὐτοὺς καὶ ἔλεος, καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰσραὴλ τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.
controles.kjv: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.
controles.livre: E todos os que andarem conforme esta regra, paz e misericórdia estejam sobre eles, e sobre o Israel de Deus.

versos.grego: Τοῦ λοιποῦ κόπους μοι μηδεὶς παρεχέτω· ἐγὼ γὰρ τὰ στίγματα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἐν τῷ σώματί μου βαστάζω.

controles.web: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.
controles.kjv: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.
controles.livre: De agora em diante, ninguém me perturbe, porque trago no meu corpo as marcas de Jesus.

versos.grego: Ἡ χάρις τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μετὰ τοῦ πνεύματος ὑμῶν, ἀδελφοί· ἀμήν.

controles.web: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
controles.kjv: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.  Unto the Galatians written from Rome.
controles.livre: A graça do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo seja com o vosso espírito, irmãos. Amém!
